d:
Enjoy the beautiful song "Kajre Badarwa Re" from the 1966 movie Pati Patni. It's a classic tune that brings back the charm of old Bollywood🏻 !!!
Credits:
Song Name : Kajre Badarwa Re
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: R.D. Burman
Lyrics: Anand Bakshi
Movie: Pati Patni (1966)
Cast: Sanjeev Kumar, Nanda, Mumtaz, Mehmood and Johnny Walker
